description: California Metropolitan Planning Organization (MPO) is a dataset listed in Caltrans GIS Data hub, an open geospatial data hub of a state transportation department, published or maintained by Caltrans. This dataset contains the geographic boundaries of Metropolitan Planning Organizations (MPO) and is intended for metropolitan area multimodal transportation planning applications. MPOs designate the federally mandated and federally funded transportation policy-making organization in the United States. Coverage: California, United States. The hub lists this as a dataset of Caltrans. Its keywords are MPO Boundaries, Caltrans, California Department of Transportation, CAOpenData, CalSTA, California State Transportation Agency. The bounding box given is -123.6325,32.5288,-114.1312,41.1850. The hub shows 2025-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-caltrans-gis-data-hub.
